dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Software Bill of Materials across CNCF projects
dashboard.description: This instance of BOMHort ingests the SPDX and CycloneDX SBOMs published by CNCF projects, cross-references known vulnerabilities via the OSV database, evaluates license compliance against a configurable policy, and applies OpenVEX statements to suppress non-applicable findings.
dashboard.disclaimer: Disclaimer: Data is provided on an "as-is" basis for informational purposes only. Vulnerability and license information is sourced from third-party databases (OSV, GitHub) and may be incomplete or delayed. This site is not affiliated with or otherwise sponsored by CNCF.
